title: L’Dor Vador
program_note:
L’Dor Vador is a setting of the regular sabbath text for children’s choir.  It was commissioned by the Cantor’s Assembly for Shabbat Yachad.

From generation to generation we will declare Your greatness, and to all eternity proclaim Your holiness.  And our praises of you, our God, will never cease to the end of time, for you are a great and holy God and King.  Blessed are you, O Lord (blessed be He and blessed be His name), the holy God.  Amen.
